order_book: The highlight from the previous call to this call is that we have added a further 60 crore or even more to our order book.
If you recall the Q4 presentation, the order book was 600 crore, we are now showcasing an order book of 660 crore.
guidance: During today's call, the management will discuss the company's operational and financial performance for the first quarter of FY27, followed by an update on key business developments, strategic priorities and the outlook
In terms of industry outlook, if you look at CX as a service and AI as a service, the combination shows very good growth, almost 35 to 40%, and that is the market we are eyeing.
capex: That is one reason we have won new logos also, and these new logos, as well as the existing account expansion, have helped us in terms of better profitability during Q1 FY27.
The reason you see expansion of the order book from 600 crore to 660 crore is that we added iQor BPO as a new logo, which itself has added close to 60 to 65 crore of new business.
risks: We see a good market and a good opportunity there, and we do not want to delay things, so a lot of action is happening.
focus: That 60 crore of new orders has come from new customers we onboarded, primarily international customers, and we will cover this in the subsequent slides.
With Paresh, Murali and Kailash, the id ea is how we can scale this global AI infrastructure vertical, which is a new vertical for us.
The idea is how we can create an integrated solution offering for existing customers and also explore the new customer base.
